visualSystem.evidence: No typography scale, hero anatomy, institutional palette, thematic color policy, spacing rhythm, card geometry, button hierarchy, focus specification or mobile layout thresholds.

journey.evidence: Hero, summary, field groups, result and explanation are named; preparation, numbered steps, confirmation and post-result guidance are not contracted.

result.evidence: Result Card is mandatory and must be clear/explainable, but primary-result dominance, scenario context, inputs, intermediate values, formula, rounding, table, interpretation and actions are not required.

content.evidence: FAQ and related links are mandatory; complete guide, sources and methodology are absent, while product/downloads are optional without configuration contract.

validation.evidence: Names structure/SEO/JSON-LD/accessibility/runtime/component validation but defines no comparator, screenshots, browser, mobile viewport, density, overflow or visual parity metrics.

enforcementProblem: Acceptance criteria can be satisfied by existence-only interpretation; no minimum depth or measurable pass/fail thresholds prevent a generic form page from passing.
